exclusions.title: Exclusions
exclusions.no_app: None, open the app to exclude.
exclusions.hint: The clock will not appear above the apps listed here.

display.title: Display
display.show_on_desktop: Always show clock (not only above fullscreen apps)

clock.title: Reset clock appearance?
clock.body:
Restore all the settings in the Clock tab.
The clock will be moved to the upper-right corner.

exclusions.title: Clear all exclusions?
exclusions.body:
Clear the entire exclusion list.
The clock will start appearing over every app again.

tutorial.title: Restart tutorial?
tutorial.body: The app will restart and the tutorial will be shown again.

tutorial.no_scroll_hint: No scroll wheel? Click to continue…

skip.title: Skip the tutorial?
skip.body: You can run it again any time from the settings.

tutorial.step1:
Hello! I'm your new clock!

I only appear above fullscreen apps, but I wanted to say hi!
tutorial.step2: Right-click me to unlock my position.
tutorial.step3:
When I'm unlocked, arrows appear and you can drag me around.

Move me to a screen border
and I'll snap to it!
tutorial.step5: To fine-tune my position you can hover the arrows (or me) and use the mouse scroll wheel.
tutorial.step6: When I'm unlocked, you can open the settings from the cog icon.
tutorial.step7: If I'm not visible, you can open the settings by double-clicking my tray icon.
tutorial.step8:
In the settings window you can change how I look and hide me from specific apps.

You can always drag me while the settings are open.
tutorial.step9: That's it! See you next time you're gaming or watching something. Bye!

newer_config.title: Update {app}
newer_config.body: Your settings belong to a newer version of the app.
